data.one_liner: Code quality analysis for Flutter and Dart with architecture, maintainability, and safety checks.
data.what_it_does: fCheck analyzes local Flutter and Dart projects for architecture, maintainability, and safety issues. It generates deterministic console, JSON, and diagram reports with 0-100% compliance scoring and can be used as a CLI tool or integrated as a Dart package.
use_when: You need automated code quality checks and architecture enforcement for Flutter projects.
You want deterministic compliance scoring for CI/CD pipelines.
You want to build custom tools, IDE integrations, or AI review pipelines that consume project metrics.
avoid_when: You only need standard linting rules provided by official flutter_lints.
You require online cloud services or external AI calls for code analysis (fCheck is strictly local and private).
strengths: Single local analysis pass covering architecture, dead code, localization, hardcoded strings, and duplicate code.
Provides both a CLI tool and a full Dart API for embedding quality metrics into custom apps and tools.
Deterministic execution with zero network calls and full privacy.
weaknesses: Running synchronous analysis on very large codebases requires offloading to a background isolate to avoid UI jank.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally via pub or add as a dev dependency, then run fCheck on your project directory.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Dart lint rules if you only need standard static analysis integration.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Recommended lint rules for Flutter applications without complex architecture scoring.
